description:
Add doc comments to documented-by-RFC Chat type-crate enum variants and other items currently lacking missing_docs.

Current count (verified 2026-05-10): 276 missing-doc warnings in jmap-chat-types.

Verify with: RUSTDOCFLAGS="-W missing_docs" cargo doc -p jmap-chat-types --no-deps --all-features

Bulk are Property enum variants and similar RFC-defined named identifiers. Cite the relevant Chat draft section (e.g. "draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 §X.Y") on each variant doc. Largest single sub-task of JMAP-sc1b.15.
title: missing_docs sweep: jmap-chat-types (276 warnings)
